source: github.com/genshinsim/gcsim at gcsim_commit — internal/characters/<key>/*.go (AGPL-3.0; MIT for code before 2026-09-19)
note: Elemental Skill particles per cast for the formula estimate's energy model (DESIGN_team_math_fallback.md §2.11, TASKS 14). Each count is read off the QueueParticle call it cites; `lines` names each cited line and a substring it must contain, and tests/unit/test_formula_energy_data.py holds every entry to the committed snapshot of those lines (gcsim_lines.json, scripts/gcsim/snapshot_particle_lines.py). A random count is its expectation (2 + 0.25 for Bennett's tap). `collector` says who catches the particles: `caster` lands them while the caster is still on field (a teammate's are caught off field), `active` is an off-field generator whose particles the on-field character catches. A summon whose particles come with a chance per hit (Raiden's Eye, Oz, Kuki's ring, Kokomi's jellyfish, Zhongli's stele) carries `chance` (the literal on its `Rand` line) and a hit cadence (`interval`, `max_seconds`), each cited to gcsim and to KQM; `particles` is chance x particles per hit. `on: burst` counts a source once per burst rather than per skill cast (Oz from Fischl's burst). `refunds` are flat energy (gcsim `AddEnergy`, never multiplied by ER): `per` burst or cast, `count` a trigger, `amount` (or `amount_row`, a talent row in our catalogue at the build's level), `recipients` team or self, `scaling` none, per_er (x the giver's ER) or raiden_a4 (x 1 + 0.006 x whole percent of ER above 100%). `weapons.favonius` is the Favonius proc (chance and cooldown from the catalogue's refinement row). `shared_icd: true` says the particle ICD is shared by every summon of the source (Yae's totems), so skill casts do not multiply it. `resonances.electro` is Electro resonance's particle (one a qualifying reaction, a cooldown, the team elements that can react with Electro). `not_curated` names characters left to the user, and why; it is empty since Yae was curated at gcsim's rate (DESIGN_team_math_fallback.md §2.11, DECISIONS.md §48-49).

sources.label: Eye of Stormy Judgment (coordinated attacks)
sources.note: Each coordinated attack has a 50% chance of one particle; the Eye strikes at most every 0.9 s (54 frames), only when the active character hits, and lasts 25 s. KQM's realistic rate, one strike a second, is used: 30 particles a minute.
sources.kqm: keqingmains.com/raiden/ — Mechanics: "The realistic amount can go lower to 30P/M when triggered once per second, or 27P/M when triggered every 1.1 seconds."

refunds.label: Musou Isshin (burst): energy to every member
refunds.note: Up to 5 restorations a burst, once a second, each to every member as flat energy. Her A4 raises each by 0.6% per whole 1% of her ER above 100% (needs ascension 4; without it the amount is the row's).

sources.label: Oz (from Nightrider)
sources.note: Oz attacks about once a second for 10 s (gcsim: every 59 frames, 10 attacks in 600 frames; KQM: 10 hits in 10 s), each with a 67% chance of one particle. The summoning hit drops none.

sources.label: Oz (from Midnight Phantasmagoria)
sources.note: The burst summons Oz too, with the same particles: counted once per burst. Each Oz is counted for up to 10 s of the rotation; a rotation shorter than both summons together counts more Oz time than it has.

sources.label: Grass Ring of Sanctification

sources.kqm: library.keqingmains.com/characters/electro/kuki-shinobu — Sanctifying Ring: "45% chance to generate 1 Particle on hit."; "C0: 8 ticks, 12s duration"; "DoT interval: 1.5s".

sources.label: Tengu Stormcall (its aimed shot's Ambush)
sources.note: 3 particles when the Ambush hits, and the Ambush comes from the fully charged aimed shot she fires in Crowfeather Cover after the skill: one per cast if that shot is fired.

refunds.label: Decorum (A4): energy to every member
refunds.note: When the Ambush hits, 1.2 energy for every 100% of her ER to every member, once every 3 s: one per cast with the aimed shot.
refunds.kqm: library.keqingmains.com/characters/electro/kujou-sara — Decorum: "Kujou Sara will restore 1.2 Energy to all party members for every 100% Energy Recharge she has."

sources.label: Sesshou Sakura (lightning strikes)
sources.note: gcsim's rate (owner ruling 2026-11-15): one particle on a totem's strike, with a 2.5 s particle ICD shared by all her totems, and each totem strikes every 176 frames (2.93 s). The ICD is shorter than a totem's own cadence, so one totem drops a particle on every strike, and more totems standing together add none: one every 2.93 s while totems stand, however many there are (a native gcsim run at the pin: one totem and three both drop one every 176 frames). Totems last 25 s at the pin (15 s, and 10 s more from Edict of Cleansing, on by default in gcsim and ungated in the game data), so skill casts do not multiply this source. KQM's library disagrees: it says only each totem's first strike drops one (about 3 for a triple cast), against gcsim's 8 for a totem set at full length.
sources.kqm: keqingmains.com/yae-miko/ — Skill Timing Trick: "the first Sesshou Sakura hit occurs about 2s after you cast the Skill. Every following hit takes 3s." Disagreeing: library.keqingmains.com/characters/electro/yae-miko — "Each Sesshou Sakura hits up to 5 times, but only the first one generates Particles".

refunds.label: Stairway to Heaven (A4): 15 energy back
refunds.note: 15 flat energy when his burst ends. The 15 it also gives every member of the element it absorbed is not counted: which element is absorbed depends on the fight, so enter it as flat energy.

favonius.note: On a crit by the wielder while the wielder is the active character, a chance (refinement param 0) to drop 3 clear particles, then a cooldown (refinement param 1, seconds). Chance and cooldown are read from the weapon's refinement row in our catalogue; gcsim computes the same from the refinement (0.5 + 0.1 R, 810 - 90 R frames).
favonius.kqm: library.keqingmains.com/combat-mechanics/energy — "3 Clear Elemental Particles are generated when the passive procs"; "Refinements only change the frequency of Particles produced, not the amount of Particles."

electro.name: High Voltage
electro.note: In a party of four with two or more Electro members, an Electro reaction on an enemy distributes one Electro particle to the team at once (no landing delay), at most once every 300 frames (5 s). gcsim triggers it on Overloaded (Pyro), Superconduct and its Stellar-Conduct form (Cryo), Electro-Charged and Lunar-Charged (Hydro), and Quicken, Aggravate and Hyperbloom (Dendro), so a team can trigger it only with a Pyro, Cryo, Hydro or Dendro member. KQM's resonance table names Superconduct, Overloaded and Electro-Charged, and Swirl onto Electro; gcsim, the oracle here, adds the Dendro reactions and not Swirl.
electro.kqm: library.keqingmains.com/combat-mechanics/elemental-effects/elemental-resonance — High Voltage: "Superconduct, Overloaded, and Electro-Charged have a 100% chance to generate an Electro Elemental Particle (CD: 5s)."
